note: Bootstrap inventory for a representative Debian 13 (Trixie) ProxyPilot-managed host. Package versions are canonical Trixie versions where confirmed from Debian sources; others are estimated from the Trixie release window (August 2025) plus security-update cadence through July 2026. ProxyPilot agent should overwrite this with its authoritative hourly dpkg snapshot. This run corrected several fields that were wrong in the prior bootstrap (see per-field notes below) — the previous inventory's php8.2-default assumption and several package-version estimates did not match confirmed Debian sources found this run.

hosts.kernel_note: CONFIRMED below fixed baselines for two CRITICAL-tier CVEs found 2026-07-08: CVE-2026-31431 'Copy Fail' (fixed 6.12.85-1) and CVE-2026-46333 'ssh-keysign-pwn' (fixed 6.12.89, public PoC exists). See cve-inbox. This kernel field has not been refreshed since the 2026-05-04 bootstrap; if the real host has since rebooted onto a newer kernel this note is stale — re-verify with uname -r.

listening_sockets.note: ProxyPilot admin backend — upgrade to INTERNET if host has WAN-routable IP
ProxyPilot frontend — upgrade to INTERNET if WAN-routable

curl.source: https://packages.debian.org/trixie/curl (via web search, 2026-07-08); corrects prior 8.11.0-1~deb13u2 estimate
curl.note: 19 open (unfixed) trixie security issues tracked upstream per security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/source-package/curl as of 2026-07-08; see cve-inbox for the subset ProxyPilot tracks

containerd.io.note: from Docker official Debian repo; verify with dpkg

systemd.note: still an ESTIMATE of the running version — verify with dpkg-query. CONFIRMED CONTEXT: fixed baseline for CVE-2026-29111 is 257.13-1~deb13u1 (Debian 13.5, 2026-05-18); if this host hasn't updated since the 2026-05-04 bootstrap it is likely still on an older, vulnerable 257.x build.

redis-server.note: still an ESTIMATE of the running version. CONFIRMED CONTEXT: DSA-6020-1 (Oct 2025) fixed trixie redis at 5:8.0.2-3+deb13u1 (covers CVE-2025-46817/46818/46819/49844); if this host hasn't updated it is likely still vulnerable. 3 additional CVEs (CVE-2026-23479/23631/25243, disclosed 2026-05-08) remain UNFIXED in trixie as of 2026-07-08 regardless of patch level — see cve-inbox.

php8.4-cli.note: CORRECTION: Debian 13 trixie's DEFAULT php is 8.4, not 8.2 as the prior bootstrap wrongly assumed (8.2 was bookworm/Debian-12's default). Fixed baseline for CVE-2025-14178/14177 per DSA-6088-1.

php8.2-cli.note: NOT trixie's default (that was bookworm/Debian-12). Only present if explicitly installed alongside php8.4, or via sury.org for an app pinned to 8.2.

caddy.note: PRIORITY GAP: from Caddy official releases (not Debian packages); installed at /usr/bin/caddy; version check: caddy version. Three CVEs disclosed Mar-Apr 2026 (CVE-2026-30851 CVSS 8.1, CVE-2026-27589, CVE-2026-27590) are fixed by upgrading to >=2.11.2 — cannot confirm exposure without a real version read. This is the single highest-value field for the ProxyPilot agent to populate on its next inventory refresh.
